opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for government tuition fee support, must be enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at a Scottish higher education institution for academic year 2026‑27.
opportunities.summary: Grants cover tuition fees up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students in Scotland for the 2026‑27 academic year.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income Scottish households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, with a place on an eligible taught or research master’s programme beginning in 2026/27.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 per year to support postgraduate master’s study for eligible students in Scotland.
